name: AI Business Operations Orchestrator
tag: A team of AI agents that handles the marketing, follow-ups, invoices and scheduling busywork of a small business.

scenarios.title: Get next week ready
scenarios.ask: Get next week ready: {posts} posts, follow-ups to {leads} quiet leads, chase {invoices} overdue invoices and fix my calendar.
steps: Drafted {posts} social posts and scheduled them for the best times.
Wrote follow-ups to {leads} leads who went quiet.
Found {invoices} unpaid invoices over 30 days and drafted reminders.
Blocked focus time and moved 2 meetings that clashed.
followups: Not unless you allow it. Posts, emails and reminders wait in an approval list, and you can approve them all at once or one by one.
How does it know my voice?
It reads a few of your past emails and posts and copies your tone. You can correct a draft once and it remembers the change.
The outreach agent marks the lead as active, drafts a reply for you and stops the follow-up sequence for that person.

scenarios.title: Close out the month
scenarios.ask: Close the month: match {transactions} bank transactions, send {invoices_out} new invoices and give me a one-page summary.
steps: Matched {=round(transactions * 0.94)} transactions to categories. {=transactions - round(transactions * 0.94)} need your eye.
Built {invoices_out} invoices from logged work and sent them for approval.
Compared spending with last month and spotted software subscriptions you no longer use.
Wrote a one-page summary: money in, money out and what's owed to you.
followups: No. It does the matching and drafting so your bookkeeper or accountant reviews instead of typing. They still sign off.
Which accounting tools does it work with?
It can connect to common small-business accounting tools or work from a CSV export from your bank.

scenarios.title: Check out a new service idea
scenarios.ask: I'm thinking of adding a {price} add-on service. Research it and design the launch post and flyer.
steps: Checked how 8 similar local businesses price this. Typical range: ${=round(price * 0.8)} to ${=round(price * 1.3)}.
Made a launch flyer and two social images in your brand colors.
Drafted an email to current customers and a launch post.
followups: How reliable is the uptake estimate?
It's a planning estimate, not a forecast. Running the email to a small group first gives you a real number before you commit.
Yes. Ask in plain words, such as 'make it brighter' or 'add our phone number', and the design agent redraws it.
